en: Attendant
Welcome to the Safari Zone!
I'm sorry, but you can't come in without a Pokéblock Case. The Pokémon here are fond of Pokéblocks, and every visitor should carry some.
The receptionist at the Contest Lobby in Lilycove City gives a Case to anyone who asks. Do come back with one!
Catch as many Pokémon as you like for just $500! Would you like to play the Safari Game?
That's $500, thank you. Here are your Safari Balls.
{player} received 30 Safari Balls!
We'll let you know when your game is over. Until then, off you go into the wild!
I'm sorry, you don't have enough money.
All right. Please come and play another time!
Attendant
Walk along the counter toward the zone's door, and I'll ask whether you'd like to play the Safari Game.
text: Mergi de-a lungul ghișeului spre ușa zonei și te voi întreba dacă vrei să joci Jocul Safari.

en: Attendant
Welcome to the Safari Zone! Pokémon you'll hardly ever see in Hoenn live here in the wild.
text: Bine ai venit în Zona Safari! Aici trăiesc în sălbăticie Pokémoni pe care în Hoenn abia îi vezi.

en: And trainers may catch them to keep. Come in and enjoy yourself!
text: Iar Antrenorii îi pot prinde și păstra. Intră și distrează-te!

en: Attendant
Welcome to the Safari Zone! Is this your first visit?
text: Bine ai venit în Zona Safari! E prima ta vizită?

en: You go in with 30 Safari Balls, the only balls you may throw inside.
text: Intri cu 30 de Safari Balluri, singurele mingi pe care ai voie să le arunci înăuntru.

en: The game is over when you've thrown your last ball, or when you've walked 500 steps.
text: Jocul se termină când ai aruncat ultima minge sau când ai făcut 500 de pași.

en: Come in and enjoy the Safari Zone!
text: Intră și bucură-te de Zona Safari!
